Dear Dr. McAllister,

Enclosed is our preliminary inquiry to The Council For Tobacco Research-U.S.A., Inc. regarding a grant application entitled "Endothelial-leukocyte adhesion molecules in inflammation and tissue injury". We are very enthusiastic concerning to the potential outcome of these studies on the roles of ELAM-1 and INCAM-110 in important pathophysiological processes.

It is anticipated that Dr. Lo will be an Instructor in Pathology prior to the potential funding of this application.

Sincerely,
